annotation.title_clean: Council Decision (CFSP) 2025/2539 of 11 December 2025 amending Decision (CFSP) 2022/2269 on Union support for the implementation of a project 'Promoting Responsible Innovation in Artificial Intelligence for Peace and Security'
annotation.title_en: Council Decision (CFSP) 2025/2539 of 11 December 2025 amending Decision (CFSP) 2022/2269 on Union support for the implementation of a project 'Promoting Responsible Innovation in Artificial Intelligence for Peace and Security'
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Council CFSP decision granting a no-cost extension, to 31 March 2026, of the UNODA-implemented project on responsible AI innovation for peace and security. The extension addresses diversity problems, including visa difficulties for Global South participants, and allows capacity-building for civilian AI and policy communities there.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Article 5 of Decision (CFSP) 2022/2269 so the project expires 39 months after the contribution agreement.
Extends the UNODA project to 31 March 2026 at no additional cost.
Extension responds to diversity challenges, including visa difficulties for Global South participants.
Adds dissemination and capacity-building for civilian AI and policy communities in a Global South region.
Enters into force on adoption, 11 December 2025.
